data.text:
Nagpulong kahapon ang mga opisyal ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA), kasama ang mga kinatawan mula HPG, PNP, DOTr, NLEX, SLEX, at lokal na pamahalaan ng Metro Manila, upang talakayin ang mga nakalatag na traffic at safety measures ngayong Undas.

Ayon kay MMDA General Manager Usec. Procopio Lipana, mahalaga ang pagtutulungan ng bawat ahensiya at LGUs upang maibsan ang inaasahang bigat ng daloy trapiko at pagdasa ng mga publiko na pupunta sa mga sementeryo.

Napagkasunduan ang agarang paglalagay ng mga help desk, pulis at traffic personnel simula Oktubre 29 sa mga bus terminals pati na rin sa mga pangunahing sementeryo sa Kalakhang Maynila.   

Simula Oktubre 25, activated na ang MMDA Oplan Undas 2025 para sa maayos at mapayapang paggunita ng Araw ng mga Santo at Araw ng mga Kaluluwa ngayong taon. 

#mmda #undas2025

data.text:
Kim Taehyung [#V] captivated global fans with his new Celine autumn photoshoot, showcasing his signature charm through wet hair, doe-like eyes, and a brown leather jacket. The post received 3.74 million likes on Instagram in six hours and over 36,000 engagements on X, reflecting immense worldwide attention.

His look — a brown leather jacket, Boston bag, and red necklace — highlighted his refined fashion sense and natural allure. Fans from around the world reacted passionately, flooding social media with illustrations, praise, and viral comments admiring his visuals.

Beyond his photoshoot, V also made a major impact at Paris Fashion Week, generating $13.1 million (₩189 billion) in media value — the highest among Korean stars — and contributing 34% of BTS’s total EMV during the 2026 S/S fashion season, solidifying his status as a top global fashion icon.
